title: Evidence
description: One market-intelligence module output (MI-010). Pure, no lookahead: uses only data with timestamps <= detected_at (MI-013). An emitted record is never altered; an invalidation is a new record that references it.

schema_version.description: Schema version (DATA-010). Breaking changes need a migration and an ADR line.

params.description: Present with value FIXTURE when fixture values of unapproved parameters are in effect (RISK-005, RISK-066 item 3, MI-045). Absent otherwise; the spec names no value for the approved case.

fixture_demo_mode.description: Fixture demo only: the entry authorization mode the user set for this run in fixture_demo_mode (RISK-066 item 4). Absent outside fixture demo.

mono_seq.description: Engine monotonic sequence number for ordering within a process (DATA-003). Optional because records not written by the engine (research, Guardian ingest) have none.

module.description: Owning module (MI-020). The spec names modules in prose only, so no enum.

concept.description: Concept name from MARKET_INTELLIGENCE_SPEC §4 (e.g. REVERSAL_WARNING, REVERSAL_CONFIRMED). The spec gives no closed identifier list.

anyOf.description: Timeframe of the concept. Null only for tick-level concepts (MI-013); MI-010 does not say how those are labelled.

detected_at.description: UTC time the evidence first became knowable (MI-013).

times.description: Bar open times that define the evidence.

prices.description: Price levels that define the evidence.

anchor.description: Bar open times and price levels that define the evidence (MI-010).

confidence.description: Confidence SCORE in [0, 1] from a deterministic function of the concept's own geometry, rounded to 4 decimals (MI-011). It is not a probability and never a win chance.

condition.description: Plain statement of the cancelling condition.

invalidation.description: The price or time condition that cancels the evidence (MI-010). The spec does not structure it further.

anyOf.description: Expiry time. Nullable because MI-010 does not say every concept expires.

context.description: Descriptive context fields only (MI-032): references and descriptors, never scored. The spec lists the kinds of descriptor but not their names or types.

derived_from.description: Component evidence_ids of a derived record (MI-033/044).

params_hash.description: Hash of the strategy-version parameters used (MI-012). Hash function assumed SHA-256; the spec does not fix it.
